title: A Tool that Autofills Job Applications ✍️
description:
This is NOT an April Fool's joke: Your online job applications are about to get a whole lot faster. 

Starting next week, you'll see a new Beta "Autofill Application" button in the Teal Chrome extension when you're on select sites.

Choose a resume from your Resume Builder and a job from your Job Tracker, and in just a few clicks, you can pair the two and autofill your job application in under 30 seconds.

The feature's still in Beta and will be 100% free for at least the first 30 days (also not an April Fool's joke).

Over the next month, we'd love your feedback:

 What's working
 What's not (we see you, job applications on Workday!)

AI can be a great way to build and keep momentum on tasks that are draining and difficult, but it takes care and attention to use it well, so we want to make sure we're doing it right!
#jobsearch #jobsearchtips #jobapplication
